title: CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results
chineseTitle: 第 16 章：戴安娜受邀赴茶会

paragraphs.en: October brought vibrant colors to Green Gables, with birches turning golden and maples in royal crimson. Anne was thrilled by the beauty around her.
paragraphs.zh: 十月到来时，绿山墙的景色变得五彩斑斓：白桦树披上了金装，枫树则化作了皇室般的深红。安妮被四周的美景深深吸引。

paragraphs.en: One Saturday morning, she rushed into Marilla's arms, holding colorful branches. "Oh, Marilla, I'm so glad we have Octobers! It would be terrible if we skipped from September to November.
paragraphs.zh: 一个星期六的早晨，她扑进玛丽拉的怀里，手里拿着五彩缤纷的树枝。“哦，玛丽拉，我们有十月真是太好了！要是从九月直接跳到十一月，那该有多糟糕啊。”

paragraphs.en: Look at these maple branches—they give me several thrills. I’m going to decorate my room with them."
paragraphs.zh: 看看这些枫树枝——它们让我感到兴奋不已。我要用它们装饰我的房间。

paragraphs.en: Marilla, unimpressed by aesthetics, said, "Messy things. You clutter your room too much with outdoor stuff. Bedrooms are for sleeping."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉对美观不以为意，说道：“乱七八糟的东西。你房间里放了太多户外的东西，卧室是用来睡觉的。”

paragraphs.en: Anne replied, "And dreaming, Marilla. Pretty things make better dreams. I'll put these in the old blue jug and set them on my table."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮回答说：“还有幻想呢，玛丽拉。美好的事物能让梦境更加精彩。我把这些花插在旧蓝罐里，放在我的桌上。”

paragraphs.en: Anne promised to be careful about dropping leaves. Marilla was going to a meeting of the Aid Society at Carmody that afternoon and wouldn't return until dark. She instructed Anne to get Matthew and Jerry their supper, reminding her not to forget to draw tea.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮答应小心别让树叶掉下来。玛丽拉当天下午要去卡姆多伊参加援助协会的会议，天黑前不会回来。她嘱咐安妮去叫马修和杰里吃晚饭，并提醒她别忘了准备茶水。

paragraphs.en: Anne apologized for forgetting last time, explaining she had been thinking of a name for Violet Vale. Matthew hadn’t scolded; instead, he put the tea down himself and suggested they wait. Anne told him a fairy story while waiting, making it seem like no time passed at all.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮为上次忘记道歉，解释说她当时正想着给紫罗兰·维尔取个名字。马修没有责备她，反而自己端下了茶盘，提议先等等看。在等待的时间里，安妮给她讲了一个童话故事，仿佛时间根本没流逝似的。

paragraphs.en: Marilla said, "Matthew would think it’s fine if you decide to have dinner in the middle of the night. But this time, keep your wits about you. And—though I’m not sure—I might make you more addlepated—but you can ask Diana to come over and spend the afternoon with you for tea here."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说：“马修要是知道你半夜吃晚饭，肯定觉得挺好的。不过这次可得冷静点。还有——虽然我不确定——我可能会让你变得更迷糊些，但你可以邀请戴安娜过来陪你喝下午茶。”

paragraphs.en: Anne clasped her hands with excitement. "Oh, Marilla! How lovely!
paragraphs.zh: 安妮兴奋地双手合十。“哦，玛丽拉！真是太美妙了！”

paragraphs.en: You can imagine things now, just like I've always dreamed of having a tea party. It will be so grown-up. And I won't forget to put the tea on when you have guests."
paragraphs.zh: 你现在可以想象一下，就像我一直以来梦想的那样举办下午茶聚会。那一定很像大人做的事情。而且你来客人的时候，我不会忘记把茶准备好。

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "No, Anne, no rosebud set for you. Use the old brown one instead. But you can open the yellow crock of cherry preserves and cut some fruit cake.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“不，安妮，没有为你准备玫瑰花瓣。你就用那朵旧褐色的吧。不过你可以打开那个黄色的樱桃罐头，切点果饼来吃。”

paragraphs.en: You can also have cookies and snaps."
paragraphs.zh: 你还可以吃饼干和坚果糖呢。”

paragraphs.en: Anne imagined herself sitting at the head of the table, pouring tea. "I'll ask Diana if she takes sugar, even though I know she doesn't. And then I’ll press her to take another piece of fruit cake and more preserves. It’s such a wonderful feeling just thinking about it."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮想象自己坐在餐桌上，为戴安娜倒茶。“我明知戴安娜不喜欢加糖，还是会问她要不要。然后我会劝她再吃一块果蛋糕，多喝点果酱。光想想这种感觉就如此美妙。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla said, "You can’t bring Diana into the spare room or parlor. But there's raspberry cordial in the sitting-room closet. You and Diana can have some later when Matthew is late from hauling potatoes."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说：“你不能把戴安娜带到客房或者客厅来。不过起居室的储物柜里有覆盆子汽水，等马修晚些时候从运土豆回来后，你们可以喝一些。”

paragraphs.en: Anne rushed to Orchard Slope, past Dryad's Bubble and up the spruce path. Just as Marilla left for Carmody, Diana arrived, dressed in her second-best dress. She knocked at the front door primly, unlike her usual habit of running into the kitchen without knocking.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮飞奔到果园坡，经过干adin的泡泡，沿着松树小径向上跑。就在玛丽拉要去卡姆多的时候，戴安娜到了，穿着她第二件最好的裙子。她规矩地敲了敲前门，与她平时直接闯入厨房的习惯大不相同。

paragraphs.en: Both girls shook hands gravely as if they had never met before. This solemnity lasted until Diana was taken to the east gable to lay off her hat and then sat for ten minutes in the sitting room with her toes neatly positioned.
paragraphs.zh: 两个女孩庄重地握了握手，仿佛彼此从未见过面。这种严肃的气氛持续到戴安娜被带到东屋摘下帽子，然后她在客厅里坐了十分钟，脚趾整齐地并拢着。

paragraphs.en: Anne asked Diana how her mother was, though she had seen Mrs. Barry in fine health that morning.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮问戴安娜母亲的状况如何，尽管她那天早上见到了巴里太太身体很好。

paragraphs.en: Diana replied that her mother was well and mentioned Mr. Cuthbert would be hauling potatoes to Lily Sands later.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜回答说她妈妈很好，并提到库伯特先生稍后要去莉莉沙恩挖土豆。

paragraphs.en: Their potato crop was doing well, Anne noted, asking about Diana's father’s harvest.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮注意到，他们的土豆收成不错，便询问戴安娜的父亲收获如何。

paragraphs.en: "It is fairly good," Diana responded.
paragraphs.zh: “还算不错。”戴安娜回应道。

paragraphs.en: Anne then changed the subject, excitedly saying they had picked many apples already. She suggested going to the orchard for some Red Sweetings.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮随后把话题转了开来，兴奋地说她们已经摘了很多苹果了。她提议去苹果园里摘一些红甜苹果。

paragraphs.en: Marilla allowed them to take any remaining on the trees and promised fruit cake and cherry preserves for tea. Anne hinted that Marilla would provide a red drink but didn't reveal what it was.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉让他们摘树上剩下的苹果，并承诺提供果蛋糕和樱桃果酱当茶点。安妮暗示玛丽拉会准备一种红色的饮料，但没有透露具体内容。

paragraphs.en: The girls spent most of their afternoon in the orchard, enjoying apples and chatting. Diana shared her school troubles with Anne, including sitting next to Gertie Pye, who irritated her by squeaking her pencil constantly. Ruby Gillis had a magic pebble that cured warts, while Charlie Sloane's name was written on the porch wall, upsetting Em White greatly.
paragraphs.zh: 女孩们大部分下午都在果园里度过，一边品尝苹果，一边聊天。戴安娜向安妮倾诉了她在学校的烦恼，其中包括与 constantly 挤吱作响的 GERTE PYE 坐在一起，这让她感到很烦。RUBY GILLIS 有一块能治瘊子的魔石，而 CHARLIE SLOANE 的名字被写在门廊墙上，这让 EM WHITE 非常不安。

paragraphs.en: Sam Boulter faced punishment from Mr. Phillips after being "sassed" in class. Mattie Andrews showed off her new hood and tassel-covered crossover, annoying everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 萨姆·鲍尔特因在课堂上被菲利普斯先生“ sass ”而面临惩罚。马蒂·安德鲁斯则炫耀她新买的帽子和带流苏的交叉围巾，让大家都不悦。

paragraphs.en: Anne suggested they have some raspberry cordial instead of talking about Gilbert Blythe. She found the cordial on a high shelf and set it on the table with a tumbler. Diana admired its bright red color before sipping it daintily.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮提议她们喝点覆盆子汽水，免得一直谈论吉尔伯特·布雷思。她从高高的架子上找到了那瓶覆盆子汽水，放在桌子上，并摆好了一个酒杯。戴安娜先是赞叹了一下它鲜艳的红色，然后小口品尝着。

paragraphs.en: "That's awfully nice raspberry cordial, Anne," she said.
paragraphs.zh: “这种覆盆子汽水真是不错，安妮。”她说道。

paragraphs.en: Anne was glad Diana liked it and invited her to take as much as she wanted. She then went to stir the fire, noting the many responsibilities of housekeeping.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮见戴安娜喜欢这茶，便邀请她随便多喝一些。随后，她去捅了捅炉火，一边留意着家务中的种种琐事。

paragraphs.en: Diana had already drunk two glasses of raspberry cordial when Anne returned from the kitchen. She readily agreed to have another glass, finding it exceptionally delicious. "The nicest I've ever tasted," Diana said, comparing it favorably to Mrs. Lynde's version, which she dismissed as inferior despite its reputation.
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮从厨房回来时，戴安娜已经喝了两杯覆盆子汽水。她欣然同意再喝一杯，觉得味道格外美妙。“这是我尝过的最棒的。”戴安娜说，将它与雷切尔·林德太太版本相比，尽管后者名声在外，但戴安娜还是认为前者更胜一筹。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted that Marilla's raspberry cordial would likely be better than Mrs. Lynde’s. "Marilla is an excellent cook," she said, adding that teaching her to cook was challenging due to the lack of room for creativity in cooking. Once, while making a cake, Anne got distracted by imagining a story about Diana and smallpox. She forgot to add flour, resulting in a failed attempt.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮承认，玛丽拉的覆盆子汽水可能会比林德太太的好喝。“玛丽拉是个出色的厨师，”她说，“教她做饭挺有挑战性的，因为烹饪的空间不大，无法发挥创意。”有一次，在做蛋糕时，安妮被想象中的戴安娜和天花的故事分了心，忘了加面粉，结果那次尝试以失败告终。

paragraphs.en: Marilla was upset but not surprised.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉有些烦躁，但并不意外。

paragraphs.en: Anne also recounted how she neglected to cover the pudding sauce with a mouse drowning inside it. When Mr. and Mrs. Chester Ross visited, Anne tried to act gracefully at dinner. However, when Marilla brought out the warmed-up pudding sauce, Anne panicked and blurted out about the mouse.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮还讲述了她因忽视了一只溺死在布丁酱里的老鼠而未能覆盖好酱料的故事。当切斯特·罗斯夫妇来访时，安妮试图在晚餐中表现得优雅一些。然而，当玛丽拉端上加热过的布丁酱时，安妮慌了神，脱口而出地提到了那隻老鼠。

paragraphs.en: The moment was excruciating for her.
paragraphs.zh: 那一刻对她来说无比煎熬。

paragraphs.en: Marilla then served strawberry preserves instead of the tainted sauce, but Anne couldn't eat any. She felt humiliated by Mrs. Chester Ross's gaze. After the guests left, Marilla gave Anne a stern lecture.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉于是改用草莓果酱代替了那瓶变质的酱料，但安妮连一口也没吃。她感到自己被切斯特·罗斯太太的目光羞辱了一番。等客人们离开后，玛丽拉给了安妮一番严厉的训斥。

paragraphs.en: Diana felt unwell and insisted on going home without tea. Anne, distressed, tried to persuade her to stay for at least a snack or lie down. Diana remained firm, feeling dizzy and insisting she must go.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜感到身体不适，坚持不去喝下午茶就直接回家。安妮见状十分担忧，试图劝说她至少留下来吃点小点心或者躺下休息一会儿。但戴安娜态度坚决，感觉头晕不已，坚持要马上离开。

paragraphs.en: Anne eventually took Diana to the Barry yard fence before returning home in tears. She prepared tea for Matthew and Jerry with little enthusiasm.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮最终带着戴安娜去了巴里家的篱笆旁，回家时已是泪眼婆娑。她对为马修和杰瑞准备茶点提不起多少兴趣。

paragraphs.en: On Sunday, it rained heavily all day, keeping Anne confined to Green Gables. On Monday afternoon, Marilla sent her on an errand to Mrs. Lynde's. Upon return, Anne burst into the kitchen, sobbing uncontrollably.
paragraphs.zh: 星期天整天都下着倾盆大雨，安妮被禁锢在绿山墙农舍内。周一午后，玛丽拉派她去雷切尔·林德太太家办件差事。回来后，安妮冲进厨房，抽泣个不停。

paragraphs.en: Marilla asked what was wrong, but received no response except more tears and sobs. She demanded a clear answer from Anne, who finally sat up, visibly upset.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉问安妮出了什么事，但除了更多的泪水和抽泣外，没有得到任何回应。她要求安妮给出一个明确的回答，最终安妮坐了起来，显然情绪非常低落。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde came to visit Mrs. Barry, who was in a terrible state. Mrs. Barry accused Anne of making Diana drunk and sent her home in a disgraceful condition. As a result, she vowed never to let Diana play with Anne again.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人去探望贝里太太，后者正处于极度不安的状态。贝里太太指责安妮让戴安娜喝醉了酒，并且把她送回家时状况糟糕透顶。因此，她发誓再也不会让戴安娜和安妮一起玩了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla was stunned by the accusation. "Set Diana drunk!" she exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉被这个指控惊呆了。“竟然让戴安娜喝醉了酒！”她脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, are you or Mrs. Barry crazy? What did you give her?"
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，你是疯了吗？还是巴里太太疯了？你给她吃了什么？”

paragraphs.en: Anne cried, "I only gave her raspberry cordial, Marilla. I didn't think it would make anyone drunk—not even if they drank three big tumblerfuls like Diana did."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮哭着说：“我只是给了她一些覆盆子利口酒，玛丽拉。我没想过那会让谁喝醉——哪怕戴安娜喝了三大杯也不会。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla marched to the sitting room pantry and found a bottle of homemade currant wine she had hidden in the cellar instead of the pantry. She returned to the kitchen with the bottle, her face twitching.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉大步走到起居室的储藏室，发现她把一瓶自制黑加仑酒藏在地窖里，而不是储藏室。她拿着瓶子回到厨房时，脸上抽搐了一下。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, you always manage to get into trouble," Marilla said. "You gave Diana currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. Did you not know the difference?"
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，你总是弄得一团糟，”玛丽拉说，“你把蔓越莓酒给了戴安娜，而不是给她喝覆盆子汽水。你不知道这两种东西的区别吗？”

paragraphs.en: "I never tasted it," Anne admitted. "I thought it was the cordial. I just wanted to be hospitable.
paragraphs.zh: “我从未尝过，”安妮承认道，“我以为那是药酒。我只是想表示热情好客。”

paragraphs.en: Diana got very sick and had to go home. Mrs. Barry told Mrs. Lynde she was drunk, and laughed when her mother asked what was wrong. She slept for hours after that.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜病得很厉害，不得不回家。巴里太太告诉林德太太她喝醉了酒，当母亲问她怎么了时，巴里太太还笑了。之后，戴安娜一连睡了好几个小时。

paragraphs.en: Her mother smelled her breath and knew she was drunk. Anne had a terrible headache all day yesterday. Mrs. Barry is furious and won't believe it was an accident."
paragraphs.zh: 她的母亲闻了闻她的口气，知道她喝醉了。安妮整个昨天都头痛得要命。巴里太太气得不行，说什么也不肯相信这是一场意外。

paragraphs.en: Marilla said, "Diana should have been punished for drinking too much. Three big glasses could make anyone sick, even if it's just cordial. Mrs. Barry will see reason when she hears you weren't to blame."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说：“戴安娜不该因为喝得太多而被惩罚。三杯大玻璃杯的饮料足以让人不适，哪怕只是果酒。巴里太太听你解释后会明白的，责任不在你。”

paragraphs.en: Anne replied, "I must cry. My heart is broken. Diana and I are forever separated.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮回答说：“我必须哭出来。我的心碎了，戴安娜和我将永远分离。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla, I never imagined this would happen."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉，我万万没想到会发生这样的事。

paragraphs.en: Marilla advised, "Go up tonight and explain the situation to Mrs. Barry. She'll understand once you tell her."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉建议说：“今晚上去跟巴里太太解释一下情况。你把话说清楚，她就会理解的。”

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed, "Facing Diana's mother terrifies me. You should go, Marilla. You're more dignified than I am."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮叹了口气，“想到要见戴安娜的母亲，我简直害怕得不行。你去吧，玛丽拉。你比我要有风度得多。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla agreed, "I will." By the time she returned from Orchard Slope, Marilla had changed her mind.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉应允道：“好的。”等她从果园坡回来时，玛丽拉已经改变了主意。

paragraphs.en: Anne met Marilla at the porch door, saying, "Marilla, by your face, it's been no use. Mrs. Barry won't forgive me?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在门廊前遇到了玛丽拉，说道：“玛丽拉，从你的脸色看，巴里太太是不会原谅我的了。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla snapped, "Of all unreasonable women, she's the worst! I told her you weren't to blame, but she didn't believe me. She even criticized my currant wine and said it couldn't affect anyone."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉气愤地说：“她真是所有不讲理的女人里最糟糕的一个！我已经告诉她你并没有过错，但她就是不信。她甚至还批评我的黑加仑酒，说什么那东西根本不会影响任何人。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla continued, "I told her plainly that currant wine isn't meant for three tumblerfuls at once. If a child is so greedy, I'd give her a good spanking to sober her up."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉继续说道：“我明确地告诉她，黑加仑酒不是一次喝三大杯的。如果孩子这么贪杯，我会好好教训她一番，让她清醒过来。”

paragraphs.en: Anne stepped out into the chilly autumn dusk, determinedly making her way through a sere clover field and over a log bridge. She then entered a spruce grove under the pale light of a low-hanging moon.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮踏出凉爽的秋夜，坚定地穿过一片枯黄的紫花苜蓿田，跨过木桥。随后，她进入了月光微弱、松树环绕的小树林中。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Barry answered the door with a stern expression. Anne, white-lipped and eager-eyed, stood on the doorstep.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太一脸严肃地开了门，安妮则嘴唇苍白、眼神急切地站在门口。

paragraphs.en: "Who do you think you are?" Mrs. Barry said coldly.
paragraphs.zh: “你到底是谁？”巴里太太冷冰冰地说。

paragraphs.en: Anne clasped her hands, pleading, "Please forgive me, Mrs. Barry. I didn't mean to intoxicate Diana. How could I?
paragraphs.zh: 安妮双手合十，恳求道：“拜托夫人，请原谅我。我没有打算让戴安娜喝醉。这怎么可能呢？”

paragraphs.en: Imagine if you were an orphan with just one friend—wouldn’t you protect her?"
paragraphs.zh: 想象一下，如果你是个孤儿，只有一个朋友相伴，你是不是会竭力保护她？

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Barry's anger intensified. She dismissed Anne’s words as dramatic and suspicious.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太的怒火越来越大，她 dismissive 地将安妮的话视为夸张且可疑。

paragraphs.en: "I don't think you're fit for Diana," she said cruelly, "go home."
paragraphs.zh: 她说得尖酸刻薄：“我看你配不上戴安娜，快回家去吧。”

paragraphs.en: Anne's lips trembled. "Can I see Diana once more to say goodbye?" she begged.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的嘴唇微微颤抖着，“我能不能再见戴安娜一面，向她告别？”她恳求道。

paragraphs.en: "Diana is with her father in Carmody," Mrs. Barry replied, shutting the door.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太回答道，关上了门：“戴安娜和她父亲在卡姆多伊呢。”

paragraphs.en: Back at Green Gables, Anne was devastated. She told Marilla, "My last hope is gone. Mrs. Barry treated me terribly.
paragraphs.zh: 回到绿山墙农舍，安妮心如刀绞。她对玛丽拉说：“我的最后一丝希望破灭了。巴里太太对我非常不好。”

paragraphs.en: I don't think she's well-bred. Praying won't help much against such an obstinate person."
paragraphs.zh: 我认为她不够有教养。祈祷对这种固执的人恐怕没什么用处。

paragraphs.en: Marilla rebuked Anne for saying inappropriate things, trying to suppress her growing urge to laugh. That night, when Marilla told Matthew the story, she laughed heartily at Anne’s troubles.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉责备安妮说了一些不得体的话，试图抑制住自己逐渐增大的笑意。那天晚上，玛丽拉把这件事告诉了马修，不禁对安妮的遭遇大笑了起来。

paragraphs.en: Before bed, Marilla found Anne asleep in the east gable, her face soft and tear-stained. Gently, Marilla lifted a loose curl from Anne's face. She then bent down and kissed Anne's flushed cheek on the pillow, feeling a new tenderness for the child.
paragraphs.zh: 就寝前，玛丽拉发现安妮睡在东边的山墙里，脸庞柔和而带着泪痕。玛丽拉轻轻抬起一根散开的卷发，然后弯下身子，在枕头上吻了吻安妮通红的脸颊，心中涌起一股新的柔情，对这个孩子产生了更深的怜爱。
